name: sfu_chain_rta-a-COMMIT
purpose: [el1011-hbm-sfu idle1012] SFU sigmoid chain (hard child of the ot_su12_sfu lane cluster, slot of hfd_sfu x16 per quarter) through tools/ref_tile: exact abstract + TT/FF/SS + insertion (hand view b70b0112c lacks TT lib / PG M5). Pins W face toward lane logic.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_chain u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/phys/ot_hdc_v41x_su_c12_phys.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_vec_lane_c12.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_c12.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_vec_side_c12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay_ring.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fpu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_pipe.sv rtl/proto/ot_fp32_add_rne_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_fdiv.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_softplus.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp_lat_c12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_f12.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_add6.sv rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_dsrom_su_f12.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_fsqrt_c12.sv rtl/hdc/v41/ot_hdc_fsqrt.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: c12_campaign_exact
bench.cmd: python3 tools/hbm_su_c12.py campaign --gsh 1 --kimm 1 --denr 1 --dring 4 --sfut 1 --quick --only random --no-1024 --scratch {RUN}/bw --out {RUN}/bench_pos.json > {RUN}/bench_pos.log 2>&1; grep -E 'random N=' {RUN}/bench_pos.log; n=$(grep -c 'pass=True' {RUN}/bench_pos.log); ! grep -q 'pass=False' {RUN}/bench_pos.log && [ $n -ge 5 ] && echo SFU_EXACT_PASS
bench.note: random N16 x3 + N64 x2 vs golden; the vehicle stage needs python tokenizers (absent on the fleet), as in the GSH/KIMM bench

bench.name: c12_neg_ring3_read_late
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/negative_src && cp -a rtl tools {RUN}/negative_src/ && cd {RUN}/negative_src && sed -i 's/localparam integer JR = (j - 1 + N) % N;/localparam integer JR = (j - 2 + N) % N;/' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_c12.sv && grep -q 'JR = (j - 2 + N)' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_c12.sv && python3 tools/hbm_su_c12.py campaign --gsh 1 --kimm 1 --denr 1 --dring 4 --sfut 1 --quick --only random --no-1024 --scratch {RUN}/bwn --out {RUN}/bench_neg.json > {RUN}/bench_neg.log 2>&1; grep -E 'random N=' {RUN}/bench_neg.log; grep -q 'pass=False' {RUN}/bench_neg.log && echo SFU_NEG_DETECTED && exit 1; exit 0
bench.note: Negative source isolated explicitly; its mutation never touches the route source.

bench.name: c12_neg_sfut_exp_early
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/negative_src && cp -a rtl tools {RUN}/negative_src/ && cd {RUN}/negative_src && sed -i 's/    always @(posedge clk) begin y_exp <= y_exp_c; y_div <= y_div_c; end/    always @(posedge clk) y_div <= y_div_c; always @(*) y_exp = y_exp_c;/' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_vec_lane_c12.sv && grep -q 'always @(\*) y_exp = y_exp_c' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_vec_lane_c12.sv && python3 tools/hbm_su_c12.py campaign --gsh 1 --kimm 1 --denr 1 --dring 4 --sfut 1 --quick --only random --no-1024 --scratch {RUN}/bwn --out {RUN}/bench_neg.json > {RUN}/bench_neg.log 2>&1; grep -E 'random N=' {RUN}/bench_neg.log; grep -q 'pass=False' {RUN}/bench_neg.log && echo SFU_NEG_DETECTED && exit 1; exit 0
bench.note: Negative source isolated explicitly; its mutation never touches the route source.

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.025 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/sfu_chain_rta/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/sfu_chain_rta/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/sfu_chain_rta --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_chain  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
